query:
SELECT b.id, b.bookingDate, b.status, b.clientId, b.vesselId
FROM bookings b
JOIN vessels v ON b.vesselId = v.id
WHERE v.name LIKE '%JETSKI%' AND b.bookingDate >= '2025-11-29 00:00:00' AND b.bookingDate < '2025-11-30 00:00:00'
ORDER BY b.bookingDate;
